lanupdate.button.update.tooltip: Update this mod from GitHub, or copy the mods of a friend's LAN world
lanupdate.menu.title: LAN Update Button
lanupdate.menu.update_available: A new version (%s) is available on GitHub.
lanupdate.menu.lan: Copy mods from a LAN host
lanupdate.menu.sharing: Your world is open to LAN and your mods are shared. Friends find you automatically, or can type: %s
lanupdate.menu.not_sharing: Open your world to LAN to let friends copy your mods.
lanupdate.menu.sharing_disabled: Sharing your mods on LAN is turned off in this mod's config.
lanupdate.github.title: Update from GitHub
lanupdate.github.no_release: There is no release for Minecraft %s on %s yet.
lanupdate.github.done: Version %s is installed. Restart Minecraft to use it.
lanupdate.lan.title: Copy mods from a LAN host
lanupdate.lan.intro: Ask your friend to open their world to LAN. They need this mod too. Hosts found on your network:
lanupdate.lan.manual: Or type the address shown in the host's Update menu:
lanupdate.lan.bad_address: That address doesn't look right. Example: 192.168.1.23:25580
lanupdate.lan.connect_failed: Could not reach %s. Check that the world is still open to LAN and that the host's firewall allows Java on private networks.
lanupdate.lan.version_mismatch: The host runs Minecraft %s with NeoForge %s, but you run Minecraft %s with NeoForge %s. Install the host's NeoForge version with the NeoForge installer, or some mods may not load.
lanupdate.lan.same: You already have exactly the same mods as the host.
lanupdate.lan.summary: %s mods to download (%s), %s old versions to remove, %s already the same.
lanupdate.lan.trust: Only copy mods from people you trust. Mods are programs that run on your PC.
lanupdate.lan.done_later: %s old files are still in use. They are deleted automatically when Minecraft closes.
lanupdate.lan.restart: Restart Minecraft to load the new mods.
lanupdate.configuration.title: LAN Update Button
lanupdate.configuration.shareModsOnLan: Share mods while open to LAN
